extension.description: TMDb Helper liefert Details über Filme, Fernsehsendungen und Schauspieler aus TMDb. Benutzer können auf eine Vielzahl von Listen aus TMDb TVDb MDbList und Trakt zugreifen.
TMDb Helper provides details about movies, tvshows and actors from TMDb. Users can access a variety of lists from TMDb TVDb MDbList and Trakt.
TMDb Helper proporciona detalles sobre películas, series y actores de TMDb. Los usuarios pueden acceder a una variedad de listas de TMDb, TVDb, MDbList y Trakt.
TMDb Helper dostarcza szczegółowych informacji o filmach, serialach i aktorach z serwisu TMDb. Użytkownicy mają dostęp do szeregu list z serwisów TMDb, TVDb, MDbList i Trakt.
TMDb Helper tillhandahåller information om filmer, tv-serier och skådespelare från TMDb. Användare kan få tillgång till en mängd olika listor från TMDb, TVDb, MDbList och Trakt.
TMDb 助手从 TMDb（影视数据库） 获取电影、电视剧及演员的详细信息。用户可访问来自 TMDb、TVDb、MDbList 和 Trakt 的各类影视列表。

extension.news:
version 6.17.3.7 - Widgets without an id or search query (popular, trending, discover and most other lists) start a little faster: they no longer open the lookup database they do not need.
version 6.17.3.6 - Discover widgets no longer refetch from TMDb every time widgets reload (after Trakt actions or timed reloads); they use the list cache again.
version 6.17.3.5 - Faster backgrounds on low-power devices: wait until focus settles before blurring, blur a 780 px copy instead of the full-size original, write JPEG instead of slow PNG, and show the blur before the logo crop. - Fix a race that could blank the blurred background, and cut idle polling and unchanged property writes. - Only vacuum the cache database while Kodi is idle; guard Trakt stats against unexpected responses.
version 6.17.3.4 - Enforce the Primez versioning rules in the publish checks; nothing in the add-on changes.
version 6.17.3.3 - Add publish rule checks (pre-push hook and CI workflow); nothing in the add-on changes.
version 6.17.3.2 - Port upstream TMDb artwork-type fix for the images API. - Handle empty Trakt stats responses without a traceback. - Retain the CoreELEC SQLite mmap cap for ARM32 stability.
